readback.name: Poincare.existsSmoothabilitySmoothManifoldStatement
readback.mathematical_statement: For every explicit M : Type u, with the single declaration universe u arbitrary, and implicit instances of TopologicalSpace M, T2Space M, ChartedSpace (EuclideanSpace R (Fin 3)) M, SimplyConnectedSpace M and CompactSpace M, there exists a charted-space structure C : ChartedSpace (EuclideanSpace R (Fin 3)) M such that, after locally installing C as the ChartedSpace instance, M satisfies IsManifold (𝓡 3) at order ((ENat.top) : WithTop ENat). Thus every compact Hausdorff simply connected topological 3-manifold in the input class admits a smooth, boundaryless real 3-manifold atlas on the same carrier and the same supplied topology. The regularity order is smooth C-infinity, obtained by coercing the inner ENat top, and is not the outer analytic top of WithTop ENat. The input charted-space structure states the topological dimension; the conclusion may choose a different charted-space structure and does not require equality with the input atlas or smoothness of that input atlas. TopologicalSpace M is not replaced or existentially reselected. There is no explicit second-countability, metrizability, finite triangulation, orientation, Riemannian metric, curvature, flow or Hamilton-convergence assumption. Compactness, Hausdorffness and simple-connectivity are hypotheses, so this interface is not the broader claim for all topological 3-manifolds. It asserts existence of a compatible smooth structure only, with no homeomorphism to a sphere, sphere recognition, metric existence, convergence conclusion or final Poincare theorem. The supplied definition of ExistsSmoothabilitySmoothManifoldStatement has these same quantifiers; its displayed rfl equality companion only exposes that proposition and does not itself prove existence.
